description: Every point of sale (store, location, branch) the merchant has — the same list as Settings → Outlets. Answers 'how many stores do I have', 'what is the address of the King Street shop', 'what is that location’s phone number'. ALSO THE WAY TO TURN A STORE NAME INTO AN ID: the reports, inventory and station tools filter by outlet ID and never by name, so when the merchant says 'sales for King Street' or 'stock at the warehouse', call this FIRST and pass the id you find here. Returns every outlet in one call — the list is short, there is no paging and no server-side search, so match the name yourself. Deleted outlets are not returned. Outlets carry NO opening hours, timezone or currency: store hours are not stored anywhere on this platform and currency is a company-wide setting, so say that plainly instead of guessing. Per-outlet tax percentages are not here either — those belong to the tax tools.
name: hub_get_outlets
title: List outlets
